semantics.tool_call_refs: Unique raw rollout exec tool-call records; not API requests.
semantics.command_execution_items: Unique CommandExecution item IDs after folding started/completed records. One item can contain a compound shell command, so its exit code is event-level and does not prove each segment succeeded.
semantics.correlation: A raw tool-call reference is matched through extracted static shell command arguments and unique canonical command text. One compound CommandExecution item can cover multiple shell segments; missing or repeated matches remain unresolved.
semantics.successful_read: Only an actual mapped CommandExecution item with a provably simple ls/rg/sed/cat path use and exit_code 0 can count as a successful read. Missing exit codes and compound/unknown commands are unresolved.
semantics.exit_code: exit_success and exit_failure count event-level codes. A nonzero event containing stderr-suppression syntax does not identify which shell segment failed.
semantics.shell_processes: Operating-system shell process counts are not recorded.
semantics.isolation: This is a separate sensitivity analysis of the existing isolation.json. It does not replace or rewrite official verdicts and never infers clean from silence.
semantics.privacy: Raw paths, fixture name, cell IDs, commands, outputs, task text, and identities are omitted.
